components.name: Primary button
components.description: Panel-only light/dark illustrative adapter for rookPrimary() in apple/Rook/Theme.swift and Start workout in apple/Rook/RookApp.swift. Accent/on-accent values are literal native-theme mappings; browser button geometry is not shipped SwiftUI geometry or simulator evidence.

components.name: Bordered action
components.description: Panel-only light/dark illustrative adapter for native bordered +30 sec and Skip actions in apple/Rook/WorkoutView.swift. Uses the source minimum target height and adaptive tint; adapter borders do not specify SwiftUI's system-managed bordered fill, radius, or states. Not shipped web UI or simulator evidence.

components.name: Numeric field
components.description: Panel-only light/dark illustrative adapter for labeled, centered rounded-border workout fields in apple/Rook/WorkoutView.swift. Empty fields intentionally avoid fabricated records. CSS pixels adapt the native minimum target; browser Field/CanvasText retain semantic foregrounds. Not native keyboard behavior, shipped web UI, or simulator evidence.

components.name: Native navigation
components.description: Panel-only text-only light/dark adapter for the four native TabView destinations in apple/Rook/RookApp.swift. Browser buttons illustrate destination hierarchy and tint, not native tab-bar geometry, SF Symbols, navigation motion, or a functional tab implementation. Not shipped web UI or simulator evidence.

components.name: Route progress and completion
components.description: Panel-only light/dark illustrative adapter for per-exercise ProgressView and incomplete/completed controls in apple/Rook/WorkoutView.swift. Demonstration states are not workout history. Inline geometric vectors stand in for SF Symbols; browser progress geometry remains browser-managed. Not shipped web UI, native state transitions, or simulator evidence.

narrative.overview:
Rook is a native iPhone Operate interface for recording sets between efforts. Route markers makes completed work and the next editable set easy to find through adaptive navy/slate surfaces, warm amber interaction tint, and clear completion marks.

Native SF typography, Dynamic Type, lists, controls, and navigation carry the interface. Brand expression stays in adaptive roles and meaningful markers; decorative motivation, rings, and dense dashboard chrome do not belong in the active-workout surface.
keyCharacteristics: Adaptive navy/slate surfaces with amber interaction tint.
System SF text styles, tabular training values, and generous touch targets.
Native list hierarchy and explicit incomplete/completed set markers.

rules.name: The Native Foreground Rule
rules.body: Keep primary text system-managed and pair each adaptive accent with its matching on-accent foreground.

rules.name: The Dynamic Type Rule
rules.body: Use semantic SwiftUI text styles and let Dynamic Type change both text and layout instead of freezing a point-size scale.

rules.name: The Platform Depth Rule
rules.body: Let native grouping and presentation establish depth instead of adding custom shadows or web-style glass.

dos: Do preserve Route markers, adaptive navy/slate surfaces, amber interaction tint, and explicit completion states.
Do keep system primary text, SF text styles, Dynamic Type, and native control geometry.
Do preserve explicit minimum 44 pt workout targets and accessibility-size vertical set rows.
Do retain the explicit secondary-text role on the active-workout exercise footer.
Do use stored completed sets for previous values, history, and separate Progress.
Do keep native navigation, presentation motion, and destructive confirmations.
donts: Don't introduce a new metaphor, decorative rings, or dense dashboard chrome into the active-workout surface.
Don't turn system controls into fixed-size web components or invent app radii, shadows, breakpoints, or hover behavior.
Don't add the deferred inline workout chart or fabricate previous values or workout history.
Don't treat illustrative panel previews as shipped UI or simulator evidence.
Don't extend the footer-only ship disposition into security, hardware, or VoiceOver assurance, trademark clearance, or delivered HealthKit/Watch support.
